releaseNotes:
🌟 Premium UI & Status Saver Action Buttons Overhaul (v1.0.5) by Dhiraj:
• 🎨 Ultra-Premium Status Card Design: High-elevation rounded cards (18dp) with gradient scrims, frosted glass badges, and smooth ripples
• 💎 High-Visibility Save & Share Buttons: Vibrant emerald Save circular button & frosted Share button with modern vector icons
• 🖼️ Immersive Preview Modal: Rounded dark glass bottom sheet with full-width Save to Gallery and Share buttons
• 🔄 High-Visibility Refresh Controls: Crisp vector refresh icon on royal blue toolbar + in-screen refresh
• 🎙️ Deleted Voice Note Recovery & In-Chat Audio Player
• 📄 Export Chat to PDF (1-tap document sharing)
• 100% Data Preservation: All your existing saved messages and media remain intact
